hypothesis: A deterministic whole-block energy combining forward and reverse statistics can identify exact blocks from fewer transmitted syndrome bits than causal coding while retaining full-depth exact fallback.

mechanism.causal_state: bounded order-8 forward and reverse bit contexts learned from prior reconstructed blocks

promotion_gate: Exact archive must beat the matched causal control and forward-only syndrome form after all depth, syndrome, header, finalization, and source bytes.
kill_gate: Retire v1 if bidirectional syndrome inference is not smaller than both controls or bounded exhaustive decoding is not scalable.
